description: Complete Invoice and Payment management admin features. Invoices.js has partial admin view with status filter and mark-as-paid button, but no create/edit modals. Payments.js likely needs similar enhancements. Add create invoice modal (MembershipId, TotalAmount, InvoiceDate, DueDate, Status), edit invoice modal, and create payment modal (MemberId, Amount, PaymentMethod, PaymentDate, InvoiceId if linking to invoice). API: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/Invoice, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/Payment. Invoice statuses: 'Pending', 'Paid', 'Overdue'. Payment statuses: 'Completed', 'Pending', 'Failed'.
steps: Read API/DTOs/Invoice/CreateInvoiceRequest.cs and UpdateInvoiceRequest.cs - fields: MembershipId, TotalAmount, InvoiceDate, DueDate, Status, Description

Read API/DTOs/Payment/CreatePaymentRequest.cs and UpdatePaymentRequest.cs - fields: MemberId, InvoiceId (nullable), Amount, PaymentMethod ('Cash', 'Card', 'QRCode'), PaymentDate, TransactionId, Status

In wwwroot/js/invoices.js: replace showCreateInvoiceModal() placeholder with full implementation - form with MembershipId dropdown (fetch /api/Membership for active memberships), TotalAmount number input, InvoiceDate date picker (default today), DueDate date picker (default 7 days from invoice date), Status dropdown ('Pending', 'Paid', 'Overdue'), Description text input. Submit to POST /api/Invoice
In wwwroot/js/invoices.js: implement showEditInvoiceModal(id) - GET /api/Invoice/{id}, pre-fill form (allow editing TotalAmount, DueDate, Status, Description), PUT /api/Invoice/{id}
In wwwroot/js/invoices.js: add delete button in table (Admin only) - DELETE /api/Invoice/{id} with confirmation
In wwwroot/js/payments.js: check existing renderPayments() function - if it's basic like invoices.js, add admin role check and create/edit modal placeholders if missing

In wwwroot/js/payments.js: implement showCreatePaymentModal() - form with MemberId dropdown (fetch /api/Member), InvoiceId dropdown (fetch /api/Invoice?status=Pending for unpaid invoices, make optional), Amount number input, PaymentMethod dropdown ('Cash', 'Card', 'QRCode'), PaymentDate date picker (default today), TransactionId text input, Status dropdown ('Completed', 'Pending', 'Failed'). Submit to POST /api/Payment
In wwwroot/js/payments.js: implement showEditPaymentModal(id) - GET /api/Payment/{id}, allow editing Status mainly, PUT /api/Payment/{id}
In wwwroot/js/payments.js: add delete functionality (Admin only) - DELETE /api/Payment/{id}
Ensure both modules follow existing table rendering patterns with pagination, search, and role-based action buttons
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create invoices by selecting membership, entering amount, dates, and status
Admin can edit invoices (change amount, due date, status)
Admin can delete invoices with confirmation
The existing 'Đã TT' (mark as paid) button continues to work
Admin can create payment records by selecting member, optionally linking to invoice, entering amount and payment method
Invoice and payment tables display with proper badges for status (success/warning/danger colors)
verification: Start API, log in as Admin, navigate to Hóa đơn page
Click 'Tạo hóa đơn', select membership, enter details, submit - verify invoice appears
Edit an invoice's due date and status, save - verify update
Navigate to Thanh toán page, click create payment, fill form, submit - verify payment appears
Edit a payment status to 'Failed', verify badge color changes
findings:
FEAT-003 Invoice and Payment Management CRUD implementation completed successfully.

Invoices.js:
- Create invoice modal implemented with MemberId and MembershipId (optional) dropdowns, amount validation (min 1), date pickers with defaults (today and +7 days), and description field
- Edit invoice modal implemented (status-only editing per UpdateInvoiceRequest DTO which only has Status field)
- Delete functionality with confirmation added (Admin only)
- Existing mark-as-paid button preserved
- Status badges: Pending=yellow, Paid=green, Overdue=red, Cancelled=gray
- Active memberships filtered in dropdown

Payments.js:
- Complete rewrite from placeholder to full CRUD implementation
- Create payment modal with MemberId dropdown, InvoiceId dropdown (pending invoices only, optional), Amount, PaymentMethod (Cash/Card/QRCode/BankTransfer/MoMo/ZaloPay), PaymentDate (default today), TransactionId, and Status fields
- Edit modal implemented as read-only view because UpdatePaymentRequest DTO has no editable fields per backend schema
- Delete functionality with confirmation (Admin only)
- Status badges: Completed=green, Pending=yellow, Failed=red
- Table now shows Member ID, Invoice ID, Amount, Date, Method, and Status columns with action buttons

API discrepancies noted:
- CreateInvoiceRequest has MemberId (required) + MembershipId (optional), not just MembershipId as initially described
- UpdateInvoiceRequest only allows Status updates, not TotalAmount/DueDate/Description as requested - edit modal adjusted to match actual DTO
- UpdatePaymentRequest is empty - payments cannot be edited after creation, only viewed and deleted

Build passed with only unrelated warnings (package version mismatches and async method warnings in existing code).
